claim: In Eq. (19) of Oszmaniec and Kuś, “On detection of quasiclassical states” (arXiv:1111.1005; J. Phys. A 45 (2012) 244034), the phrase “increasingly ordered eigenvalues” is incompatible with the displayed antiunitary convex-roof formula and must be read as nonincreasingly ordered, \(\mu_1\ge\mu_2\ge\cdots\ge\mu_r\). If the printed descriptor is instead read literally as \(\mu_1\le\mu_2\le\cdots\le\mu_r\), then for every use of the formula with \(r\ge2\), positivity gives \(\mu_1-\sum_{j=2}^r\mu_j\le\mu_1-\mu_2\le0\), so the stated roof collapses to zero. The cited Uhlmann proposition gives the same formula with descending eigenvalues. In the paper’s two-qubit setting, the Bell-white-noise family \(\rho_p=p|\Phi^+\rangle\langle\Phi^+|+(1-p)I/4\), with \(|\Phi^+\rangle=(|00\rangle+|11\rangle)/\sqrt2\), has spin-flip singular values \(b=(1+3p)/4\) and \(a=(1-p)/4\) threefold; hence the corrected formula gives \(\max\{0,(3p-1)/2\}\), while the literal printed ordering gives zero. At \(p=1/2\), the discrepancy is \(1/4\) versus \(0\). The correction concerns only the ordering descriptor in Eq. (19), not the paper’s representation-theoretic theorems.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; exact rational replay is supplementary
integrity.ownership_basis: The arXiv record lists 81R30 first among its MSC classes.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: Uhlmann is credited with the descending-order antiunitary roof formula; Oszmaniec and Kuś are credited with the quasiclassicality application.
integrity.verification_basis: The source text, the cited Uhlmann proposition, an elementary ordering inequality, and an exact Bell-white-noise witness agree on the correction.

scientific_limitations: The correction is limited to the eigenvalue-ordering descriptor attached to Eq. (19).
No claim is made that the underlying antiunitary convex-roof theorem or the Bell-white-noise concurrence formula is new.
An informal or unindexed correction could exist even though targeted searches did not locate one.
title: Corrected eigenvalue ordering in the antiunitary quasiclassicality roof
